import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query hourly NO2 data for all 18 stations for June 2025 (excluding NULLs)
query = text("""
SELECT 
    station_id,
    AVG(no2) as mean_no2,
    COUNT(*) as num_readings
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND no2 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY station_id
ORDER BY mean_no2 DESC
""")

df_no2 = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Mean NO2 per station for June 2025:")
print(df_no2)

# Get the station with highest mean NO2
worst_station_id = df_no2.iloc[0]['station_id']
worst_mean_no2 = df_no2.iloc[0]['mean_no2']
print(f"\nStation with highest mean NO2: station_id={worst_station_id}, mean_no2={worst_mean_no2:.2f}")

# Retrieve the geographic coordinates of this station
query_station = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = :station_id
""")

df_station = pd.read_sql(query_station, engine, params={'station_id': worst_station_id})
print(f"\nStation details:")
print(df_station)

# Store results in shared variables
station_name = df_station.iloc[0]['name_en']
station_lon = df_station.iloc[0]['longitude']
station_lat = df_station.iloc[0]['latitude']

print(f"\nStation name: {station_name}")
print(f"Longitude: {station_lon}")
print(f"Latitude: {station_lat}")

# Stage the results for downstream use
worst_no2_station_id = worst_station_id
worst_no2_station_name = station_name
worst_no2_station_lon = station_lon
worst_no2_station_lat = station_lat
